    isDraft # True if rule is a draft
    ruleType
    warehouseUuid
    intervalMinutes
    intervalCrontab
    startTime
    timezone
    creatorId # The email of the user that created the monitor
    updaterId # The email of the user that last updated the monitor
    prevExecutionTime
    nextExecutionTime
    lastCheckTimestamp
    snoozeUntilTime
    slackSnoozeUser # The slack user who last snoozed the rule
    conditionalSnooze
    eventRollupUntilChanged # If true, roll up events until the condition changes
    eventRollupCount # The number of events to roll up into a single incident
    # schedule
    dcScheduleUuid
    dataCollectionDcScheduleUuid
    customSql
    override

    # generatedBy
    entities # Tables referenced in query
    # dataSource

    customSamplingSql # Custom query to sample the data on breach
    # sqlBlocks # SQL blocks used on the monitor
    # generatedRules
    # queries
    entityMcons # MCONs for monitored tables/views
    renderedCustomSql
    # scheduleConfig
    # dataCollectionScheduleConfig
    # notificationSettings
    isSnoozed # True if rule is currently snoozed
    migratedToUuid # UUID of the rule this was migrated to, if applicable
    # fieldMetric # Field quality rule parameters (if query generated by getFieldMetricQuery)
    # fieldQueryParameters # Field query parameters (if query generated by getFieldQuery)
    queryTemplateId # Query template ID (if query generated by getQueryTemplate)
    # queryTemplateVariableValues # Values for the template variables (if query generated by getQueryTemplate).
    suggestedCustomSamplingSql # A suggested investigation query for this rule based on ML model
    # selection # Selection of the monitored queries
    isOotbReplacement # Indicate if this rule replaces the default ootb detector
    isMigratedFromFieldQuality # Indicate if the monitor was migrated from a field quality (metrics legacy) rule
    connectionId # The connection UUID associated with the rule
    timeout # Timeout for the SQL query
    mcSql # SQL query for the monitor
    # tags # The monitor tags.
    dataQualityDimension # Data Quality Dimension of the monitor.
    domainUuids # Domain UUIDs assigned to the monitor.
    notifyRuleRunFailure # DEPRECATED: Replaced by failure audiences
    variables # Variables for the query
    # variableDefinitions # Variables definitions used in the query
  }
}
